example_prompts: Checkout has been returning 500 errors since a deploy ten minutes ago and about 90% of payments are failing. Set the severity and tell me what to do first.
Production is down and I'm the on-call engineer. Give me the first 15 minutes of steps and a first status update I can post.
Write a customer update about today's outage: image uploads failed for about 70 minutes this morning and are working again.
Write a blameless postmortem for last night's outage. A config change at 22:10 broke checkout for about half of users: errors from 22:14, on-call paged 22:31, rolled back 22:48, recovered 23:02.
